reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a performed behavior — “the man speaks,” with a dialogue line — so the action is request-governed; the audio reference supplies only voice timbre and delivery, not the figure's behavior.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is supplied; the sole asset is an audio voice-timbre reference, so the rendering medium is request-governed per the pinned medium decision.
reasons.wardrobe: There is no visual reference and no observed subject plate, and the request names no clothing, so wardrobe resolves from the request alone.
reasons.lighting: No illuminating source, direction, or visible light quality is specified, and no visual reference exists to inherit lighting from, leaving lighting request-governed.
reasons.framing: The request specifies no shot scale, viewpoint, composition, or camera movement — aspect ratio and duration are not framing instructions — so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No color grade, saturation, or tonal contrast treatment is requested and no visual reference supplies one, so palette is request-governed.
